strict_obstacle: Within the current synthetic scaffold and registered demand points, A-window ramp passage changes from non-zero at qMain=3500 to zero at qMain=3650 while the preregistered local mainline EJMI is not identified at either point. The scenario therefore loses demand-window ramp passage before it presents the registered protectable mainline-side state.
scope_limits: No realistic long upstream freeway feeder state is observed.
EJMI is an exploratory sufficient signature and is not a formal Breakdown or Capacity Drop definition.
Shared R/U stopped exposure does not establish causal additional U loss.
Two seeds do not establish statistical robustness.
No controller benefit or sweet spot has been tested.
